articles.title: Two Monster Black Holes From the Dawn of Time
articles.summary: Astronomers found two giant black holes shining side by side just 900 million years after the Big Bang, far earlier than theories can explain.

articles.title: Potatoes Grow in Moon Dust
articles.summary: Scientists grew potatoes through their whole life cycle in simulated moon dust mixed with nutrient-rich compost.

articles.title: A Tiny Spider With a Genome Bigger Than Yours
articles.summary: A tiny California trapdoor spider named after Stephen Colbert has a genome about 50 percent larger than a human's.
